findings.statement: Causal engagement history supplies a useful manufacturing forecasting task, while the proposed memory equation lacks superiority over matched robust and tree controls.
findings.applicability: Whole workpieces retain both screw locations and every reuse cycle; prior torque allowed only after completed same-hole operation.
findings.limitations: 27/2500 assigned operations lack the 700–1300 degree target window. Prediction includes the first sampled crossing 250 degrees and overshoot; this must not become arbitrary future access.
